import json
p = json.load(open('.exp_agent/round_plan_01.json'))
entries = []
for r in p['rules']:
    spec = r['semantic_spec']
    rule = r['rule']
    locations = []
    for f in r['files']:
        locations.extend(f['locations'])
    if rule == '@performance/hp-arkui-use-local-var-to-replace-state-var':
        entities = [\"Index component's synchronous ASN.1 verification output accumulator across all read and write methods\"]
        invariants = [
            \"state ownership and reactive UI reads\",
            \"evaluation order and output sequencing\",
            \"temporary calculation lifetime and external mutation\"
        ]
        evidence = [
            \"Text(this.result) is the sole UI read in Index.build; no other file reads or writes result.\",
            \"The click handler invokes every listed read/write method synchronously in a fixed order, and each method only appends diagnostic text to result.\",
            \"EntryAbility only loads pages/Index and no lifecycle hook, watcher, parent, or child mutates this output.\"
        ]
        transformation = \"Preserved Index and every method signature; reset a plain resultBuffer before the existing synchronous call sequence, redirected method appends to that accumulator, and assigned the completed buffer once to reactive result after the sequence.\"
    elif rule == '@performance/hp-arkui-remove-unchanged-state-var':
        entities = [\"Index.message initialized from app.string.run and read by the build Button\"]
        invariants = [
            \"state ownership and reactive UI reads\",
            \"resource identity and user-visible value\"
        ]
        evidence = [
            \"message has one initializer, no assignments, no watcher, no lifecycle mutation, and is only read by Button(this.message).\",
            \"The base and zh_CN resources both define the existing non-empty app.string.run key.\"
        ]
        transformation = \"Preserved the message field and its resource value while removing only the unnecessary @State decorator.\"
    else:
        entities = [\"Index.message resource lookup initializer\"]
        invariants = [
            \"resource identity and resource type\",
            \"fallback and exception behavior\"
        ]
        evidence = [
            \"The existing lookup is getContext().resourceManager.getStringSync("'$r('"'app.string.run')); the same generated app.string.run resource is used.\",
            \"The base and zh_CN string resources define run, so the resource identity and locale selection remain unchanged.\"
        ]
        transformation = \"Preserved the existing getStringSync call and resource reference, passing the generated resource identifier via "'$r('"'app.string.run').id.\"
    entries.append({
        'rule': rule,
        'relative_path': r['files'][0]['relative_path'],
        'locations': locations,
        'owning_entities': entities,
        'invariants': invariants,
        'evidence': evidence,
        'transformation': transformation,
        'status': 'repaired'
    })
report = {
    'selected_rules': [r['rule'] for r in p['rules']],
    'consulted_specs': {
        r['rule']: [r['semantic_spec']['core_spec_path']] + [f['spec_path'] for f in r['semantic_spec']['families']]
        for r in p['rules']
    },
    'consulted_guides': {},
    'entity_repairs': entries,
    'unresolved_external': []
}
body = json.dumps(report, indent=2) + '\\n'
print('*** Begin Patch')
print('*** Add File: /workspace/.exp_agent/round_completion_01.json')
for line in body.splitlines():
    print('+' + line)
print('*** End Patch')
